name: lesson13-14_git_and_github
description: 1. Make Sure you already setting your git to connect to the github ```shell git config --global user.name "your_username" git config --global user.email "your_email" ``` 2. open your vscode, terminal -> new terminal -> cmd (hit enter) 3. type git init ```shell git init ``` 4.rename the branch to main ```shell git branch -m main ``` 5. connect your git local and github using this command  ```shell git remote add orgin https://your-repository-url ```
